initializationAction: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run function sinnoh:triggers/stopsound');

pages.speaker: npc
lines: "Wow! You're great! You've earned my respect! I think your focus and will bowled us over totally. Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you this! ' + q.player.username + ' received the Icicle Badge from Candice. That Icicle Badge I just gave you? Because you have it, you can use the hidden move Rock Climb anytime, even when you're not in a battle. Oh, and take this, too. That's the move Avalanch. If the user takes damage, the move's power is doubled! Can you imagine what sort of focus you'd need to pull it off? Do you think I should try to act more like an Ice-type Gym Leader? Like, do you think I should be more cool and distant? That sort of thing I have trouble with."
